family.schneider-vga-at.description: Modular 286 towers with integrated VGA and System 40 and 70 variants.
family.schneider-vga-at.history: The VGA AT brought VGA video to Schneider's compact tower line. The Classic Computing catalogue dates System 40 to 1989, following the EGA Tower AT machines. The 40 and 70 names distinguish disk configurations; their 286 CPU card separates them from the 386SX machines that reused parts of this design.
